about_the_game:
Choose your battles. Earn your power. Conquer the arena.

Arena II is a fantasy battle game where you test your might in a series of escalating arena challenges. Grow stronger with every victory — by leveling up, buying better weapons and armor, and facing off against increasingly formidable foes.

Along the way, discover hidden arenas, mysterious artifacts, and mythical creatures that change the tide of battle. Crush elite bosses to earn rare rewards.

With a complete game experience designed to be beaten in about 30 minutes, this is a perfect bite-sized RPG for players who love progression, strategy, and fantasy action.

Key Features

  • ⚔️ Arena-Based Combat: Pick your next fight and face off against fantastical foes.

  • 💰 Resource Management: Earn gold and silver to upgrade gear and improve your odds.

  • 🛡️ Progression: Buy and equip better weapons and armor and level up to enhance your stats.

  • 🐉 Boss Encounters: Unlock powerful enemies and defeat them to earn rare rewards.

  • 🎨 Unique Art Style: Immerse yourself in a fantasy world.

  • ⏱️ Quick Yet Complete: Full game experience that can be completed in 30 minutes, perfect for short sessions.

Think you’ve fought your last battle? Think again. Arena II hides celestial secrets and ultimate trials for only the bravest champions.

  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
